# BrainTwin Desktop — pipeline Python dependencies
#
# Direct dependencies only. Every pin is exact, per docs/15-BUILD_AND_ENVIRONMENT.md.
# "Latest" silently changes results between runs, which is a reproducibility failure that
# surfaces during write-up when it is most expensive.
#
# The full transitive tree is captured in requirements.lock.txt, generated by
# scripts/setup-env.sh after a successful install. The lock file is the reproducibility
# artifact; this file is what a human edits.
#
# Interpreter: Python 3.12. NOT the Fedora 44 system Python (3.14) — antspyx publishes no
# cp314 wheel and would be forced to build ITK from source. See scripts/setup-env.sh.
#
# Versions below were resolved against cp312 manylinux on 2026-08-15 and verified to exist.
# Anything marked PLACEHOLDER is blocked on an open ADR and is not yet pinned.

# --- Core image and DICOM I/O -------------------------------------------------
nibabel==5.4.2
pydicom==3.0.2
SimpleITK==2.5.6

# --- BIDS layout (pipeline stage 1) -------------------------------------------
pybids==0.18.1

# --- Registration: ANTs binding (pipeline stages 4, 6, 7) ---------------------
# antspyx supplies N4 bias correction and affine/deformable registration.
# The Elastix alternative named in docs/15 is not pinned; choosing between them is
# deliberate future work and would be an ADR, not a silent swap.
antspyx==0.6.3

# --- Lesion segmentation (pipeline stage 9) -----------------------------------
# torch is installed separately by scripts/setup-env.sh from the CPU-only index.
# Rationale: the reference machine's discrete GPU is an MX230 with 2 GB VRAM, which
# cannot hold nnU-Net 3D inference. The CUDA build would cost ~2.5 GB of disk to be
# unusable. torch 2.8.0 satisfies nnunetv2's `>=2.1.2,!=2.9.*` constraint.
nnunetv2==2.8.1

# --- Numerics and tabulation --------------------------------------------------
# numpy and scipy upper bounds are set by antspyx 0.6.3. Do not bump either without
# re-resolving the whole set.
numpy==2.3.5
scipy==1.15.3
pandas==3.0.5

# --- Evaluation harness (eval/, built before the segmenter — rule 7) ----------
# Metric implementations (Dice, HD95, ASSD) come from SimpleITK, already pinned above.
matplotlib==3.11.1

# --- Organ manifests (docs/04) ------------------------------------------------
# Manifests are YAML because docs/04 specifies organs/<organ>/manifest.yaml. Validation
# itself is hand-written in app/braintwin_core/organ_manifest.py rather than delegated to
# jsonschema: docs/04 requires the specific failing field be reported, and a hand-written
# check says "geometry.layers[1].mesh is missing" where a schema library says the document
# failed. Licence register entry in docs/13.
PyYAML==6.0.3

# --- Test ---------------------------------------------------------------------
pytest==9.1.1

# --- Not pinned yet, blocked on an open decision ------------------------------
# PLACEHOLDER  parcellation backend (FastSurfer / SynthSeg) — blocked on ADR-006,
#              canonical coordinate space and parcellation atlas. docs/06 stage 8.
# PLACEHOLDER  defacing tool (pipeline stage 2) — no ADR raised yet. docs/06 stage 2.
# PLACEHOLDER  record store driver — blocked on ADR-007. docs/05.
#
# System binaries, not pip packages. Installed by scripts/setup-env.sh:
#   dcm2niix   pipeline stage 1, DICOM to NIfTI conversion
